mapper.select: select s.*, 0 as file_count, 0 as total_size_bytes from file_storage_space s where s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and s.deleted = 0 order by s.default_flag desc, s.id asc limit 1
mapper.update: update file_storage_space set default_flag = 0 where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and deleted = 0
mapper.select: select count(1) from file_storage_space where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and deleted = 0 and default_flag = 1
mapper.update: update file_storage_space set default_flag = 1 where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and deleted = 0 order by id asc limit 1
